items.prompt: Which statement about estimating sums is true?

options.text: Claim every estimate has one exact value
An estimate is close, not exact; state the rounding method before judging reasonableness.

items.explanation: An estimate is a close answer, and it helps to say how you rounded, like to the nearest hundred.
198 rounds to 200 and 303 rounds to 300, so 198 + 303 is about 200 + 300 = 500.

items.prompt: Which is NOT true about estimating?

options.text: Claim every estimate has one exact value

items.explanation: An estimate is a close guess, not an exact value. Different rounding can give different estimates.
198 rounds to 200 and 303 rounds to 300, so 198 + 303 is about 500.
199 is 1 less than 200, so 350 + 199 = 350 + 200 − 1 = 549. Compensation keeps the estimate close to the exact sum.
